boundaryGate.question: BiliDili real-project cold-start e2e: after all P1-P5 product phases are controller accepted, does the host-agent cold-start output become consumable knowledge rather than grade-A staging inventory?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili project under the local AlembicWorkspace test responsibility. Exercise the actual AlembicPlugin MCP host-agent chain with current AlembicCore/AlembicPlugin main commits accepted in this demand. The object is the end-to-end runtime/data result: plan -> bootstrap -> per-dimension submit_knowledge -> dimension_complete -> recipe persistence -> staging sweep/tick -> Skill files -> vector semantic memory/search -> P5 content quality on newly generated Recipes.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted P1 Core staging lifecycle and P1 Plugin tick-on-access sweep with raw evidence.
Controller accepted P2 Plugin dimension_complete skill flow with raw evidence.
Controller accepted P3 Core primitives and Plugin completeness critic consumer with raw evidence.
Controller accepted P4 Core dead embed config cleanup and Plugin Ollama local embedding enablement with raw evidence.
Controller accepted P5 Plugin recipe content quality gate with raw evidence: commit ed556c34cbd354b65de9cd2ee7d33c1a3f49adca, build:check and targeted tests green.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili Swift project, not synthetic fixtures, for the cold-start run.

Use the current built/local AlembicPlugin runtime and accepted AlembicCore dependency; if the host MCP cache must be refreshed, record the exact refresh boundary without treating stale-cache failure as product pass/fail.
Use a test-isolated/backup-safe data root or explicitly preserve any existing BiliDili data before destructive rebuild; do not delete user data without a recoverable backup path.
Run the host-agent flow through actual MCP tools: alembic_plan draft+confirm, alembic_bootstrap, alembic_submit_knowledge, alembic_dimension_complete, status/search checks.
Use Ollama local qwen embedding if available/enabled as specified; if the host cannot access Ollama, report the exact runtime/config blocker instead of faking semantic-memory success.
successMeans: Recipe rows are not all lifecycle=staging after a bounded tick-on-access sweep; grade-A/auto-approvable Recipes past deadline become active and lifecycle_transition_events records exist.
Each completed dimension has a generated Alembic/skills/<dimension>/SKILL.md and reported skillCount reflects real files.
Coverage moves beyond floor-only where project evidence supports it, and completeness critic visibly identifies or closes important uncovered patterns without hard padding.

Semantic path is live when Ollama is enabled: submit no longer reports embed-provider-missing, semantic_memories has entries, and alembic_search semantic retrieval returns relevant BiliDili Recipe evidence.
Newly generated Recipes satisfy P5: doClause/dontClause are English imperative/negative imperative and content.markdown includes consistent ✅/❌ project-specific contrast.
Sampled 1-2 Recipes are true, accurate, and useful: source refs open to matching BiliDili files/snippets and the rule guides future development.
failureMeans: All generated Recipes remain staging after tick-on-access and no lifecycle_transition_events are recorded.
dimension_complete does not produce Skill files or skillCount remains zero despite completed dimensions.
Completeness critic is absent, generic, ungrounded, or forces padding instead of noPadding-respecting coverage guidance.
Embedding remains unavailable with embed-provider-missing despite configured local Ollama/qwen availability, or semantic_memories/search cannot prove semantic indexing.
New Recipes still contain non-English/non-imperative do/dont or lack ✅/❌ contrast.
Recipe samples are generic, inaccurate, source-ref broken, or not actionable for BiliDili.
cannotConclude: Do not conclude productization works from unit tests, mocked Ollama, or target prose alone.
Do not conclude failure from an unreloaded host MCP cache until the refresh/reconnect boundary is tried or recorded.
Do not conclude coverage failure merely because a dimension has fewer than 5 Recipes when noPadding/exhaustedReason proves no more core patterns exist.
Do not conclude old pre-P5 Chinese do/dont rows block this demand; P5 acceptance is for newly generated Recipes and future evolution cleanup.
Do not treat ProjectContext labels alone as source truth; spot-check raw files/snippets.
stopConditions: Product code defect found: stop with exact failing step, raw evidence, and owning repository/window.
Host/runtime cache prevents loading accepted commits after refresh attempt: stop with cache/reload blocker and next action.
Ollama/qwen unavailable or misconfigured and semantic success cannot be tested: stop with exact config/runtime blocker for P4 semantic criterion.
BiliDili project path or data root identity ambiguous: stop before destructive action.
Any requested action would change scope or require product-code edits from Test.

evidenceRequired: Exact command/tool transcript or structured JSON for plan/bootstrap/submit/dimension_complete/status/search steps, with secrets and real thread ids redacted.
Database evidence for recipe lifecycle counts, lifecycle_transition_events, skills/skillCount, semantic_memories, and sampled Recipe rows.
Filesystem evidence for generated Skill files under the BiliDili data root.
Sample Recipe evidence with sourceRefs and raw snippet/path verification.
Observed MCP/runtime logs for Ollama embedding availability and any host cache refresh boundary.
A concise final verdict mapping each success/failure criterion to raw evidence.
allowedOperations: Run real MCP host-agent tools against BiliDili with test-safe data root/backups.
Rebuild local plugin/runtime if required to load accepted commits, and clear local MCP auth/cache entries if needed for host reload.
Query local Alembic DB/files/logs for evidence.
Create temporary Test evidence files under Test-owned temp/evidence areas.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit AlembicCore/AlembicPlugin product code in Test.
Do not push, tag, publish, or bump versions.
Do not write real thread ids to tracked docs or evidence.
Do not permanently delete existing BiliDili data without backup/recovery evidence.
Do not relax evidence gates, change floor=3, reintroduce daemon, add a new provider, or alter alembic_plan contract.
